results.text: Meta-analysis of three observational studies of amlodipine/valsartan in hypertensive patients with additional risk factors. In this study, the effectiveness of amlodipine/valsartan single-pill combination was assessed in hypertensive patients with diabetes, metabolic risk or overweight.
